name: io.github.wmmg101/boardsesh-mcp
title: Boardsesh Climbing Logbook
description: Read-only access to your Boardsesh logbook across Kilter, Tension, MoonBoard and more

environmentVariables.name: BOARDSESH_USER
environmentVariables.description: Your Boardsesh display name or user id. No password needed.

environmentVariables.name: BOARDSESH_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Boardsesh account email, to unlock recommendations, search and the hold heatmap

environmentVariables.name: BOARDSESH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Boardsesh account password, used once to obtain a token

environmentVariables.name: BOARDSESH_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for grouping climbs into days (default: host timezone)
